title: NASA employee wrote a CIA remote viewing training manual

tellings.quote: one of the people at NASA wrote a CIA training manual for remote viewing.

plain: Someone working at NASA, the US space agency, wrote a training manual for the CIA, the US spy agency, on remote viewing, the practice of trying to see distant places or objects with the mind alone. The scientist Kevin Knuth, who says NASA holds back UFO data, mentions this on the show without naming the person. If true, it would mean the space agency and the spy agency shared work on psychic spying.
